system.name: Synthetic Document Analysis Service
system.scope: Public API through summary storage, including the external LLM call.

assumptions.statement: A malicious authenticated tenant can submit jobs and guess object identifiers.

trust_boundaries.name: Tenant-to-service boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary between an internet tenant and the hosted service.

threats.title: Worker retrieves another tenant's document
threats.scenario: An authenticated tenant submits or manipulates a job containing another tenant's object identifier; the worker retrieves that object if tenant authorization is not independently enforced.

existing_controls.description: The object store is described as tenant-partitioned, but enforcement is not evidenced.

recommendations: Bind immutable tenant identity to each signed job and re-authorize it in the worker.
Enforce tenant-scoped object-store permissions and add negative cross-tenant authorization tests.
threats.impact_description: Cross-tenant disclosure of customer-confidential documents could cause contractual, privacy, and reputational harm.
threats.rationale: The flow handles customer-confidential data and the asynchronous authorization mechanism is unspecified.
threats.mapping_rationale: The scenario abuses insufficient object-level and tenant authorization; CAPEC-1 and AC-3 describe the corresponding access-control weakness and enforcement outcome.
framework_mappings: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
